create_NanoChatConfig: create a NanoChatConfig instance to initialize a NanoChat model configuration
init_NanoChatModel: initialize a NanoChatModel from a NanoChatConfig configuration object
access_model_config: access the model configuration via model.config attribute
set_NanoChatConfig_parameters: set NanoChatConfig parameters such as vocab_size, hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and attention heads
configure_NanoChat_tp_plan: configure the base_model_tp_plan for tensor parallelism with colwise and rowwise sharding strategies
